versions.changelog:
Initial release — enables secure, autonomous Uniswap token swaps.

- Supports V2, V3, V4, UniswapX, and cross-chain swaps on all Uniswap-supported networks.
- Automatically extracts swap parameters (tokenIn, tokenOut, amount, etc.) from user inputs.
- Performs comprehensive safety and allowance checks before execution.
- Delegates swap execution to a dedicated trade-executor for best routing.
- Provides clear, detailed result and error reporting to the user.
